_comment: Universal Login theme, mapped from the console's dark tokens in
Keys beginning with _ are stripped before this is sent (see withoutComments
in ../auth0.ts) — the Management API rejects unknown fields.
This file covers only what the theme API can express. Spacing, control
height, widget width, line-height and letter-spacing have no fields here
There is deliberately no fonts.font_url here. It takes a single URL, and
IBM Plex Mono ships no variable face, so Regular and Medium are separate
files and the 500-weight buttons would come out as synthesized faux bold.
Both @font-face rules live in page-template.liquid instead, behind a real
monospace fallback — ULP's own stack falls through to a system SANS, so a
font that fails to load would otherwise undo the restyle silently.
